# Description

- Briefly describe what this PR changes and why (if needed).
- Inform how the change is visible:
  - to end users (changes for example in UI, behaviour, features, ...)
  - to the service (changes for example in performance, integrations, monitoring ...)
  - to developers (changes for example in code, configs, workflows, ...)
- Remember to add link to JIRA issue

# Review and testing instructions

- Briefly describe how can this PR be tested or reviewed
  - files and areas to review in code (list key files or modules)
  - setting up steps to reproduce locally (commands, test data)
  - expected results and edge cases to check
- Add manual test steps for different test cases (clear and in order):
  - first do this...
  - then do that...
  - finally, check that...
- Note if there any automated tests to run (unit, integration, e2e) and their command

# Checklist for the developer

- [ ] Project documentation is up to date
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass
- [ ] At least two reviewers added: E-kirjasto maintainers + one additional reviewer
- [ ] AI was used during the process
